claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for Leonard R Conley resolves to an official Army record for a different person, so the indexed identity remains conflicting.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Exact identifier comparison produced a different name in the official Army file; a separate exact-name row lacks the index identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier disagreement is direct official conflict evidence. Neither the unrelated identifier match nor the separate exact-name candidate is assigned to Leonard R Conley.
claims.temporal_assessment: Neither Army row can establish Leonard R Conley's chronology, occupation or employment without a Box 138 bridge.
claims.match_notes: The unrelated Army subject and both full identifiers are intentionally omitted from the public claim and exports.
